state_domain.pressure_source: retained Case 3C source input; no experimental reporting interval retained
state_domain.basis: one reactive single-liquid state at specified T, P, and apparent component feed

concentration_definitions.prepared: unloaded MEA-water preparation concentration; requires the preparation temperature and unloaded solution volume basis
concentration_definitions.analytical: loaded-solution concentration of MEA + MEAH+ + MEACOO-
concentration_definitions.apparent: source component feed totals on the analytical-MEA basis; source CO2 feed is apparent total inorganic carbon
concentration_definitions.true: nine individual reactive species in the fixed order below
concentration_definitions.diagnostic_density: a source or packet density used for a stated conversion or mapping diagnostic; never a basis relabeling

apparent_transform.description: Each row is a linear total of true-species concentrations in the fixed nine-species order.
apparent_transform.apparent_input_basis: normalized component flow amounts, mol per mol analytical MEA; CO2 flow is the source apparent total inorganic carbon

solver_start.note: The seed is an electroneutral positive interior start. Conserved C/N totals are set independently from the exact apparent source totals, as in the authoritative state packet.

issue33_reconstructed_true_species_loadi.basis: Issue 33 retained reactive true-species reconstruction; domain gate only

apparent_total_inorganic_carbon_to_analy.unit: mol apparent total inorganic carbon flow per mol analytical MEA flow
apparent_total_inorganic_carbon_to_analy.basis: retained film_states.csv Fl_CO2/Fl_MEA apparent component-flow input to the packet

loading_apparent_flow_ratio_difference.basis: apparent flow ratio minus Issue 33 reconstructed loading

selected_state.source_locator: retained Case 3C profile: film_states.csv Position=1.0; Issue 33 concentration-basis table

reaction_source_locators.R4: MEA-Thermodynamics data/reference/MEA/manifests/chemical_reaction_source_contract.json: R4 selected_source Tong2012_Table5_K5_MEA_via_Aroua1999; bundle-selected fitted coefficients

reproduction.runtime: Python 3.13 with the bundle wheel installed in an isolated environment
reproduction.source_revision_protocol: Run the resolver from a clean source commit; commit the generated result artifacts separately. The recorded source commit is not the result-containing commit.
